gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 36.0 million in 2020, representing 5.75% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by Covid-19 related reserve strengthening and historical large loss activity, particularly within the Financial Lines division (D&O, Transactional Liability, and Financial Institutions). All major direct insurance lines of business, including Marine, Energy, Property, and Casualty, as well as Reinsurance, contributed to the strengthening. The syndicate also reported a GBP 10 million net loss directly attributable to Covid-19 in its Marine & Energy and Global Re divisions.
